prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity compositional option B for the Grădina Kasper desktop homepage, 1536×1024 landscape
Primary request: Explore the same “Friendly Weekly Harvest” identity with the FEATURED VEGETABLE BOX as the dominant first-viewport object. It must feel like a household’s clear weekly choice, but never look like a literal planner, calendar, or fridge. This is a real production ecommerce homepage.
Structure: Existing homepage information architecture only. Compact navigation at top. A short bold promise occupies the upper left; one large authentic greenhouse-and-box photograph spans the center; an oversized tonal product panel is nested against the photo and keeps “Cutia Family”, price, weight, next delivery date, and add-to-cart action visible. The lower fold begins the existing highlighted-articles section with two or three spacious editorial previews. No how-it-works section.
Composition: asymmetrical but calm; featured box and CTA are the single focal moment. Use one large pale-green field and one deep-green action zone rather than many cards. Rounded corners at meaningful container scale; very few borders. Information is grouped by whitespace, background tone, and typography.
Limited palette only: primary-50 #eefbf2, primary-100 #d6f5de, primary-300 #7dd8a0, primary-600 #17844a, primary-900 #005621, primary-950 #072718; secondary-50 #f5f9ec, secondary-200 #c6dc9a, secondary-500 #7ca33f, secondary-800 #3e5024; white allowed as neutral. No other chromatic UI colors beyond natural photography.
Exact visible Romanian text: “Grădina Kasper”; “Din grădina noastră. Direct pe masa ta. Proaspăt din Brașov.”; “Cutia Family”; “150 RON”; “4–5 kg”; “Următoarea livrare: 28.09.2026”; “Adaugă în coș”; “Vezi toate cele 18 cutii”; “Articole recomandate”.
Typography: friendly rounded grotesk with strong scale contrast, compact readable metadata, no script fonts.
Constraints: immediately communicate locally grown vegetable boxes and human greenhouse work; friendly and lightly playful; mature; no invented claims; controls must read as semantic web UI.
Avoid: excessive borders, every item in a card, coral, orange, purple, gradients, glassmorphism, generic ShadCN, literal planner chrome, handwriting, rustic cosplay, luxury styling, certification badges, testimonials, ratings, discounts, fake statistics, poster composition, watermark.
